workload_workday_length_002.evidence: Unit members shall have a work day of no less than 8 hours (480 minutes) in which to perform their on-site and off-site professional responsibilities.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: Each school schedule shall provide weekly preparation time for all elementary teachers within the duty day

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Secondary: 480 minutes/week (at least one 45-min block/day); Elementary: 45 minutes/day for 156 days
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: Teachers shall be provided 480 minutes per week for preparation time within the work day in blocks no shorter than thirty (30) minutes with at least one block of forty-five (45) minutes per day within the work day.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: All preparation time allocated within the 7 hours (420 minutes) as described in 1.2 shall be utilized for duties set forth above in 2.1.1 - 2.1.12 as determined by the teacher, with the exception of being available to parents and students.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: Duty Free Lunch: Unit members shall have a duty free lunch of at least 30 minutes per day.
